topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Hey, you won't believe this! I mean, seriously, talk about a surprise. My partner's been writing a novel, and guess what? It's all about me! Can you even imagine? It’s like they’ve been sneaking around, looking at my notes, listening to my stories, and turning them into this amazing thing. I feel so seen, you know? And it’s not just some little story, it's a whole novel! It's intense and a bit awkward, but also super flattering. I keep thinking, ‘Wow, they really pay attention.’ I can't wait to read it. What a wild way to say I’ve been on your mind!
